thread:
leah: Flagging INV-8052 from Northbeam — they say billing shows a partial reserved commit proration for Nov but their contract started 2026-11-01. invoice line: `Reserved commit - Nov - $9,600 prorated 5/30`. Can billing ops check?

sam: Curious if metering merge window or a late tag rename caused this. Do we have commit start tag in the meter records?

billing-bot: Usage ingest: /artifacts/usage/INV-8052-2026-11.csv uploaded (ok). Summary shows two reserved_commit entries by tag.

clare: Customer confirms they never changed commit. Contract attestation: e-sign 2026-10-28, effective 2026-11-01.

metering-bot: Detected tag rename event for account northbeam at 2456770000 during nodepool maintenance. Old tag `commit:northbeam:2026-11` and new tag `commit:northbeam:2026-11:renamed` both present for window ~5d.

leah: That lines up. Seems the pipeline treated them as separate commits causing prorate on the smaller slice. Not ideal.

sam: Action plan: (1) do a reconciliation pass to merge identical commit tags by customer+period (2) issue provisional credit for the prorated amount pending reconciliation (3) patch metering to dedupe rename events upstream.

clare: Finance approves provisional credit up to $10k. Please include memo: "PROV-CREDIT INV-8052 duplicate commit slice due to tag-rename maintenance".

billing-bot: Provisional credit created CR-8052-PROV amount $9,600 status PENDING. Use `billing-cli credits approve --id CR-8052-PROV` to finalize.

sam: Starting reconciliation run at 2456789200. ETA 10m. Will post result.

billing-bot: Reconciliation complete: merged commit tags, updated invoice exported: /exports/invoices/INV-8052-2026-11-v2.json. Duplicate/prorated line removed. Original invoice flagged superseded.

maria: Confirmed new invoice shows single reserved_commit $9,600. Voiding provisional credit CR-8052-PROV.

clare: AR confirms no cash applied. GL change: none required. I'll close memo: "PROV-CREDIT canceled after reconciliation; no journal entries posted."

leah: Messaging sent to Northbeam AP: apologized, explained migration tag bug, reissued corrected invoice. Customer acknowledged and will pay.

sam: Follow-ups: PR to add idempotent tag handling in metering (ticket MET-210), monitoring alert for overlapping commit tags.

maria: Thanks team, good catch and fast turnaround. :clap:
